newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Top Form asks banks to extend standstill.
newsitem.headline: Top Form asks banks to extend standstill.

text.p: Underwear maker Top Form International Ltd said on Tuesday it has requested its bankers to grant an extension of a standstill agreement for an initial period up to October 31.
The original agreement comes to an end on September 30.
The company said it has submitted a debt restructuring proposal through a liaison bank to its bankers in relation to the standstill agreement.

The extension is to allow time for the banks to consider the terms and structure of the restructuring proposal, the company said. Details of the proposal will be announced as soon as an agreement is reached between Top Form and the banks, it added.

In July, Top Form said its bankers would continue to provide banking facilities to the company which would in turn provide all its assets and rights as interim security during the effective period of the agreement.
